ModMetaData.name: Immersive Raid Compression
ModMetaData.author: lyj
ModMetaData.description:
Reduces oversized late-game human, mechanoid, and manhunter threats by replacing groups of low-tier enemies with fewer, stronger vanilla or official-DLC pawn kinds. An in-game audit page shows every before/after composition and safe fallback. It does not add hidden combat stat buffs.
通过使用派系原本拥有的高阶人类兵种、机械体型号或更高价值的官方动物，减少后期超大规模威胁的单位数量。游戏内记录页面会显示每次压缩前后的详细构成与安全回退原因；不添加隐藏战斗属性 Buff。
